summary: A fresh operator install with an external database uses one external PostgreSQL instance for gateway, controller, hub, EDA and Lightspeed; an existing 2.4 external database stays but needs spec.database.database_secret (external-postgres-configuration-gateway); first create a Kubernetes secret with the connection credentials.
questions: Can AAP on OpenShift use an external database instead of the managed PostgreSQL pod?
What do I set for an existing 2.4 external database after upgrading to 2.6?
Why use an external database for AAP on OpenShift?
